CFML Language Reference: Functions

LSParseCurrency

Reads a currency amount written in the conventions of the current locale and returns it as a number. Currency symbols, thousands separators and spaces are skipped; parentheses make the amount negative.

Category

International functions

Syntax

LSParseCurrency(string)

Parameters

string
The amount to convert, for example "$1,234.50" or "($19.99)".

Returns

The amount as a number.

Usage

If the string is not a currency amount, the function throws an error; test it with LSIsCurrency first. KoldFusion understands the English (US) conventions only (see SetLocale).

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Prices = "$1,234.50|($19.99)|  $ 5|2000">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>String</TH><TH>LSParseCurrency</TH><TH>Plus 10%</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="P" LIST="#Prices#" DELIMITERS="|">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>#P#</TD><TD>#LSParseCurrency(P)#</TD><TD>#DollarFormat(LSParseCurrency(P) * 1.1)#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

See also
